as_told.title: Lead Bell scientists Grawitz and Gerlach, per Witkowski

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a Polish journalist named Igor Witkowski documented who worked on the Bell, said to be a secret Nazi German project of the 1940s. According to Michels, Witkowski found that the lead figure was Ernst Grawitz, a medical chief of the SS (the Nazi party's armed elite force), and in one telling Michels adds that Grawitz worked directly under Josef Mengele, the Nazi camp doctor. Michels tells it as part of the case that Nazi Germany ran a hidden program to build a flying machine of unusual design.
